findings.summary: Z2 (spec §2.4/§3) requires zero hits for 'research:v1-deep-research' across profiles/ bin/ src/ test/ docs/, but docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_d2_profile_01.md still contains the literal at lines 72, 78 and 93. The acceptance criterion is literally unmet in the delivered tree.

The Z2 test excludes the exact file that violates Z2. test/d2-profile.test.ts:117 skips both itself and docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_d2_profile_01.md via 'if (f === thisFile || f === devNoteFile) continue;', so the only in-scope remaining occurrence of the old channel literal is unreachable by the assertion. The check reports zero hits by construction rather than by fact, which is the zero-power check the spec §4 discipline forbids ('零功率检查比没有更坏').

The dev-note reports a stronger conclusion than the check performed: line 56 claims 'Z2 ... PASS。grep 确认零命中' and line 14 claims 'v1-deep-research 全仓零命中', while that same file holds three occurrences of the literal and the automated check was written to skip it. This is exactly the defect spec §0 names as the package's own criterion — '报告一个检查的结论时，措辞的强度必须等于检查的强度' — reproduced in the evidence for the package that exists to fix it.

The untrue-verification claim that spec §2.2 targets still exists in bin/deep-research-loop.sh:100, which tells the deployer to configure EVIDENCE_CHANNEL to an '已核实存在的证据 channel' without saying who verified it, when, or how. Spec §0 states the criterion generally ('配置文件里的一句「已核实」，会让后来者停止核验'), and the implementation corrected only profiles/deploy/agent-harness.env. Z4's test scans PROFILES_DIR only (test/d2-profile.test.ts:136), so it has no power over this remaining instance.

The V2 mutation row of the dev-note asserts that restoring TICK_CHANNEL to the old value makes Z2 fail with 'grep 非零命中', but the reported baseline for that grep is already non-zero because of the excluded dev-note. The mutation attribution therefore describes a check whose stated criterion (zero hits) is not the criterion the test enforces, so the per-assertion attribution required by spec §4 does not hold as written.

Z1, Z3, Z5, Z6 and Z8 are genuinely met and carry real power: profiles/deploy/agent-harness.env sets all eight keys verbatim per §2.1 including the first real DOC_CHANNEL and ANCHOR_CHECK_BIN values, RESEARCH_QUESTION is exactly 'agent harness', Z5 self-proves the clean child env before asserting all five rendered tick inputs equal profile values, local.env labels its TICK_CHANNEL as unverified with a create-before-run instruction, and docs/deploy.md §3 documents channel creation as an explicit deployer action. The rejection rests on Z2 and the residual §2.2 claim, not on these.
